DESCRIPTION

Janet Carroll Estate Agents is thrilled to introduce you to No. 21 Rockford Manor, a stunning 3-bedroom home crafted by Sorohan builders, boasting approximately 89 ms/ (958 sq. ft.) of living space. Nestled within an exclusive gated development off Stradbrook Road, this property offers a unique blend of comfort and tranquillity.

Set within approximately 7 acres of beautifully landscaped grounds, Rockford Manor provides a serene environment while ensuring modern living conveniences.

No. 21 is perfectly positioned to offer privacy, with unobstructed views to the front. It features a delightful sunny rear garden complete with a large patio rear and artificial lawn, ideal for relaxation and outdoor entertaining.

The location is highly desirable, with easy access to the vibrant areas of Blackrock, Monkstown, Deansgrange, and Dun Laoghaire. You can enjoy a variety of coffee shops and cafes for leisurely outings, while sports enthusiasts will appreciate the proximity to Blackrock Rugby Club just across the road, Monkstown Fitness Club and swimming pool and Monkstown Tennis Club nearby. Within walking distance of Dublin Bay and the popular Seapoint swimming spot.

Public transport options are abundant, with the 4-bus service conveniently located at either end of Stradbrook Road. The E2 bus (formerly known as the 46A) is also a close by, along with Blackrock and Seapoint Dart stations within walking distance. Direct bus to UCD and the City Centre.

Families will be pleased to find an excellent selection of primary and secondary schools in the vicinity, including CBC Junior and Senior Schools, Monkstown, Rockford Manor, Holly Park, Blackrock College, St. Andrews College, Scoil Lorcáin and Loreto Foxrock.

This exceptional property epitomizes luxurious family living. We invite you to schedule an early viewing—this opportunity is not to be missed!
